# LI.FI Across V4 packed bridge test vectors

Calls to the `AcrossFacetPackedV4` functions of the LI.FI Diamond on Ethereum.

```solidity
struct PackedParameters {
    bytes8 transactionId;
    bytes32 receiver;
    bytes32 depositor;
    uint64 destinationChainId;
    bytes32 receivingAssetId;
    uint256 outputAmount;
    bytes32 exclusiveRelayer;
    uint32 quoteTimestamp;
    uint32 fillDeadline;
    uint32 exclusivityParameter;
    bytes message;
}

// all arguments are packed after the selector
function startBridgeTokensViaAcrossV4NativePacked() external payable;
function startBridgeTokensViaAcrossV4ERC20Packed() external;

function startBridgeTokensViaAcrossV4NativeMin(PackedParameters calldata _parameters) external payable;
function startBridgeTokensViaAcrossV4ERC20Min(PackedParameters calldata _parameters, bytes32 sendingAssetId, uint256 inputAmount) external;
```

Descriptor: [`example-lifi-packed-bridges.json`](./example-lifi-packed-bridges.json)

## USDC from Ethereum to Arbitrum, packed

All arguments are packed after the selector of `startBridgeTokensViaAcrossV4ERC20Packed()`. Addresses are 32 bytes wide so that non-EVM destinations fit. The amount received is in the destination token's units, which the wallet cannot resolve, so it is shown raw.

- Chain ID: 1
- From: `0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`
- To: `0x1231DEB6f5749EF6cE6943a275A1D3E7486F4EaE`
- Value: 0 ETH

Calldata:

```

```

Expected display:

```

Refund address: 0x0000000000000000000000001111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Recipient: 0x0000000000000000000000001111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Token sent: 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48
Token received: 0x000000000000000000000000af88d065e77c8cc2239327c5edb3a432268e5831
Amount sent: 1000 USDC
Amount received: 999200000
Destination chain: Arbitrum One

Fill deadline: 2026-10-13 16:00:00 UTC
```
